name: Use OnPush change detection
statement: Declare ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush on application components and drive their view state through signals, inputs, or observable bindings.
rationale: The Agent Studio-style workbench renders dense, frequently changing views. OnPush and explicit reactive state keep updates predictable and bound unnecessary checks.

badExample.description: A component relies on default change detection

goodExample.description: The component makes its update contract explicit
goodExample.code: @Component({ selector: 'app-panel', templateUrl: './panel.html', changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush }) export class Panel {}

history.change: Initial default-on change-detection rule grounded in Quality Studio's standalone OnPush components.
